book: 译林版（三起）六年级上册
note: 这是题库格式样例，覆盖全部 5 种题型。真实项目应把 U1–U8 每单元都补齐 6 关。

units.title: Honesty
grammarCore: 规则动词 -ed 四条加法

levels.name: 挑战关
levels.note: 全部现场生成变式题，限时

questions.why: 题问的是名词“诚实”，用 honesty。honest 是形容词“诚实的”，honestly 是副词，dishonest 是“不诚实的”。

knowledge.title: honest 词族
knowledge.formula: honest(adj. 诚实的) → honesty(n. 诚实) → honestly(adv. 诚实地) → dishonest(adj. 不诚实的)
knowledge.example: He is an honest boy. Honesty is important.
knowledge.trap: 抽象名词作主语，谓语用单数：Honesty is important.（× are）

questions.why: 空格修饰动词 repaired，要用副词；careful 的副词是 carefully。

knowledge.title: 形容词变副词
knowledge.formula: 形容词 + -ly → 副词（careful→carefully, quiet→quietly, happy→happily）
knowledge.trap: 修饰名词用形容词，修饰动词用副词：a careful boy / do it carefully

questions.stem: Sam ______ a storybook on his way home yesterday.
questions.point: 一般过去时 · 时间标志词
questions.why: yesterday 说明动作已经发生，要用过去式；find 的过去式是 found。A、B 是现在时，D 是非谓语，都不能单独作谓语。

knowledge.title: 一般过去时
knowledge.formula: 肯定：主语 + 过去式／否定：主语 + didn't + 原形／疑问：Did + 主语 + 原形?
knowledge.example: Sam found a book. / Sam didn't find it. / Did Sam find it?
knowledge.trap: didn't 后面一定回原形（× didn't found）

questions.stem:
— Did you see my storybook yesterday?
— No, I ______.
questions.point: 过去时一般疑问句的简答
questions.why: Did 提问必须用 did / didn't 回答，时态要一致。No, I don't. 是本单元最大的失分点。

knowledge.title: Did 问句怎么答
knowledge.formula: Yes, I did. / No, I didn't. （不能用 do/don't，也不能用 was）
knowledge.example: — Did Sam break the glass? — Yes, he did.
knowledge.trap: be 动词问句才用 was/were 答：— Were you at home? — Yes, I was.

questions.stem: My father ________ (not go) to work yesterday.
questions.why: yesterday 是过去时间，否定用 didn't；didn't 后面动词必须还原成 go。

knowledge.title: 过去时否定
knowledge.formula: 主语 + didn't + 动词原形
knowledge.example: He didn't go to school yesterday.

questions.stem:
对划线部分提问（last week）：
Sam broke the book last week.
questions.answer: When did Sam break the book?
accept: When did Sam break the book?
When did Sam break the book
questions.point: 过去时特殊疑问句改写
questions.why: 划线部分是时间 → 用 When；原句是实义动词 broke，要加 did 并把 broke 还原为 break。

knowledge.title: 对划线部分提问（过去时）
knowledge.formula: 疑问词 + did + 主语 + 动词原形 + 其他?
knowledge.example: He developed hybrid rice in 1973. → When did he develop hybrid rice?
knowledge.trap: did 后不能再用过去式（× When did Sam broke the book?）

passage.title: 阅读 · 一则诚实的日记
passage.text:
Sunday, April 6th   Rainy
Today was a bad day for me. In the afternoon, I played football in the classroom. The ball hit Mrs Li's glass and it fell off the desk. I was afraid, so I put the broken glass into the bin and said nothing.
At night I could not sleep. I kept thinking about it. My mother saw my face and asked, “What's wrong?” I told her the truth.
“Everyone makes mistakes,” she said. “The important thing is to be honest.”
This morning I went to Mrs Li's office and said sorry. To my surprise, she smiled. “Thank you for telling me the truth,” she said. “That is more important than the glass.”
I felt much better. Now I know: honesty is not easy, but it always makes us free.

questions.why: 原文定位：The ball hit Mrs Li's glass and it fell off the desk. —— 打碎的是 Mrs Li 的玻璃杯。

knowledge.title: 细节题怎么做
knowledge.formula: 读题干 → 找关键词（break / glass）→ 回原文定位 → 比对选项
knowledge.example: 题干 break ≈ 原文 hit … fell off / broken glass
knowledge.trap: 不要凭印象选；先定位句子，再选答案

questions.stem: What's the best title for the passage?
questions.why: 全文围绕“犯错后说实话”展开，结尾点明 honesty is not easy, but it always makes us free. 其余三项只是细节。

knowledge.title: 主旨/标题题
knowledge.formula: 看首段 + 结尾句 + 反复出现的词；标题要能覆盖全文，不能只是某一段
knowledge.example: 反复出现 truth / honest / honesty → 选 Telling the Truth
knowledge.trap: 标题题最容易误选“最生动”的细节项

passage.title: 首字母填空 · 袁隆平
passage.text: Yuan Longping was a great Chinese s__1__. He was b__2__ in 1930 in Beijing. At an early age, he liked f__3__. When he grew up, he s__4__ farming. In 1964, he began to work on hybrid rice. It was very d__5__, but he never g__6__ up. He k__7__ thinking and trying, and he always stayed in the f__8__. In 1973, he d__9__ hybrid rice. Now it grows in many countries and f__10__ people all over the world.

questions.stem: 根据首字母提示填空，使短文完整。

blanks.why: a great + 名词，指“科学家”
be born in 1930 出生于 1930 年
liked + 名词/动名词；farming 农业
never gave up 从不放弃
in the fields 在田间，用复数
developed hybrid rice 培育出杂交水稻
主语 it，一般现在时第三人称单数

questions.point: 语篇填空：时态 + 词形 + 拼写
questions.why: 先通读全文定时态（前半过去、最后一句现在），再逐空判断词性与形式。

knowledge.title: 首字母填空四步
knowledge.formula: ① 通读定时态 ② 看空前词性 ③ 想搭配 ④ 检查拼写与形式
knowledge.example: he never g___ up → 搭配 give up → 过去时 gave up
knowledge.trap: 看到 never 也要看整句时态，别一律用原形

questions.stem:
— Whose book is this?
— It's ______. (这本书是她的)
questions.point: 名词性物主代词单独使用
questions.why: 问 whose 后回答“她的（书）”，要用名词性物主代词 hers，后面不能再加名词。her 是形容词性，必须后接名词。

knowledge.title: 形容词性 vs 名词性物主代词
knowledge.formula: my/mine · your/yours · his/his · her/hers · our/ours · their/theirs
knowledge.example: This is her book. = This book is hers.

units.title: Great people
grammarCore: the first + 名词 + to do

questions.stem: He never gave up ______ new ideas.
questions.why: give up 后面接动名词（give up doing sth）；× give up to do 是典型错误。

knowledge.title: 哪些动词后面只能 doing
knowledge.formula: enjoy / keep / finish / practise / give up / be good at / thanks for / how about + doing
knowledge.example: He kept thinking. / Thanks for helping me.
knowledge.trap: stop doing（停止正在做的事）≠ stop to do（停下来去做另一件事）

questions.stem: Marie Curie was the first woman ________ (win) a Nobel Prize.
questions.point: the first + 名词 + to do
questions.why: 序数词 the first 修饰名词时，后面用动词不定式作定语，to 不能省。

knowledge.title: 序数词 + to do
knowledge.formula: the first / second / last + 名词 + to do sth
knowledge.example: She was the first woman to win the prize.

questions.stem: Everyone ______ a dream. We should work hard.
questions.why: everyone 作主语时谓语用第三人称单数；本句讲普遍事实，用一般现在时 has。

knowledge.title: everyone / someone 作主语
knowledge.formula: everyone / everybody / someone / nobody + 单数谓语
knowledge.example: Everyone has a dream. / Nobody knows the answer.
